propositions: The file_impact field today has two states (declared paths or empty), where empty is ambiguous between undeclared and genuinely no-file-impact, causing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation in both cases.
Empty file_impact causes container poison: one child with empty file_impact collapses the parent's drift scope to whole-HEAD invalidation even when the child truthfully has no impact.
A tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) with required no_file_impact_reason for the none state allows precise attestation validity scoping and truthfulness review via LLM criterion.
An attestation explicitly declaring none file_impact should remain valid across unrelated commits, while undeclared tickets still invalidate on any commit.
The tri-state declaration must be part of the material fingerprint so state transitions invalidate attestations and prevent retroactive widening of validity.
